skill.name: copy-editing
skill.description: Review and improve existing marketing copy through focused editing sweeps for clarity, voice, proof, specificity, emotion, and conversion friction.
skill.summary: Systematic copy editing for clearer, stronger marketing copy.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in this prompt-only skill. Manual review found no prompt injection, exfiltration intent, executable code, or unsafe tool instructions.

content.user_title: Improve Marketing Copy With Focused Editing
content.value_statement: Marketing copy often loses impact through unclear claims, weak proof, or uneven tone. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured editing passes that preserve the message while improving clarity and conversion strength.
actual_capabilities: Reviews existing marketing copy through seven focused sweeps.
Flags unclear sentences, jargon, vague claims, and weak calls to action.
Suggests edits that preserve the original message and author voice.
Checks whether features connect to reader benefits.
Identifies claims that need proof, examples, or softer wording.
Provides quick word, sentence, and paragraph-level editing checks.
limitations: It does not write full campaigns from scratch.
It needs audience, goal, and brand voice context for best results.
It cannot verify statistics, testimonials, or external proof by itself.
It focuses on marketing copy, not legal, medical, or technical review.

use_cases.title: Landing Page Review
use_cases.description: Improve page copy before launch by checking clarity, proof, specificity, and risk near calls to action.

use_cases.title: Email Campaign Polish
use_cases.description: Refine subject lines, body copy, and calls to action while keeping the campaign voice consistent.

use_cases.title: Founder Copy Feedback
use_cases.description: Turn rough product messaging into clearer copy that explains value, audience fit, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Copy Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review for a short piece of marketing copy.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this copy for clarity, grammar, and tone. Keep the message intact and suggest specific edits: [paste copy].

prompt_templates.title: Seven Sweep Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured review of a landing page, email, or product page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the seven sweeps framework on this copy. Cover clarity, voice, so what, proof, specificity, emotion, and zero risk: [paste copy].

prompt_templates.title: Audience-Specific Edit
prompt_templates.scenario: Review copy against a known audience and conversion goal.
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this copy for [target audience] with the goal of [desired action]. Preserve our [brand voice] voice and explain each major change: [paste copy].

prompt_templates.title: Conversion Friction Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review focused on objections and calls to action.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this copy for conversion friction. Identify unanswered objections, unsupported claims, vague benefits, and risky calls to action. Suggest stronger alternatives: [paste copy].

output_examples.input: Original: Our innovative platform helps teams optimize workflows and improve productivity.
output_examples.output: Edited: Plan projects in one place, spot blockers sooner, and give your team back hours each week. Reason: The revision replaces vague claims with concrete outcomes.

output_examples.input: Original: Trusted by thousands of companies to deliver industry-leading results.
output_examples.output: Feedback: This claim needs proof. Add a named customer, a verified count, or a measurable result. If proof is unavailable, soften the claim.

output_examples.input: Original: Contact us to learn more.
output_examples.output: Edited: Book a 15-minute demo and see how the workflow fits your team. Reason: The next step is more specific and reduces uncertainty.

best_practices: Provide the copy goal, target audience, desired action, and brand voice before review.
Ask for one sweep at a time when the copy is long or strategically important.
Review suggested edits against available proof before publishing claims.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent testimonials, statistics, or customer results.
Do not use it as the only review for regulated or legal claims.
Do not request a full rewrite when you need focused copy editing.

faq.question: What type of copy does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews existing marketing copy, including landing pages, emails, ads, product pages, and calls to action.

faq.question: Does it preserve the original voice?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is designed to improve clarity and strength while keeping the author's core message and voice.

faq.question: Can it write new copy from scratch?
faq.answer: It is best for editing existing copy. Use a copywriting workflow first, then use this skill to improve the draft.

faq.question: Will it fact-check my proof points?
faq.answer: No. It can flag unsupported claims, but you must provide or verify statistics, testimonials, and customer evidence.

faq.question: Can it handle quick proofreading?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes quick checks for word choice, sentence clarity, grammar, formatting, and paragraph flow.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
